evidence.exact_quote: A string of bomb threats has affected dozens of passenger flights across Europe this week, prompting diversions, emergency landings and security checks, as well as military escorts in some cases.
The UK Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander described the incidents as “malicious hoax threats.
Moscow has repeatedly dismissed speculations that Russia could attack any NATO or EU nations as “nonsense” and “political schizophrenia.
Daily Mail ran a story on Wednesday citing a host of “experts” arguing that Moscow could be behind the scare.

framing_claims.text: El medio describe la oleada de amenazas como una serie de incidentes que han afectado numerosos vuelos, señalando también que algunos medios añaden una posible responsabilidad rusa.

actor_claims.role: describe los incidentes como amenazas falsas
